dedupe_keys.name: risk of ecological impacts due to flow alteration in the seine river catchment under future climate scenarios and reservoir management strategies

description: The STARS4Water team publishes Seine ecological-flow risk results at 155 gauging stations, including 17 downstream of four reservoirs. The public README describes four 2000 to 2020 baselines with different reservoir representations, four 2070 to 2098 climate scenarios with and without reservoirs, and nine management strategies at downstream gauges. Ecological Risk due to Flow Alteration classes compare simulated flow-regime indicators with baseline conditions. This public ZIP and README are labelled CC BY 4.0 by Zenodo. A reservoir-operation or drought simulation could use the station results to compare environmental-flow consequences across management cases. The risk scores are derived screening indicators, not observed ecological losses. The related source discharge simulations have their own Zenodo deposit and are not duplicated here. The README was inspected but the ZIP's station mapping and individual values were not opened. No catalogue record explicitly covers these Seine risk scenarios.
